_doc: @canonical-ok — 'v2' is NOT a version bump of anima/: it is a parallel toy research substrate that coexists permanently with core/ (owner-named, 2026-07-16). FROZEN gate constants — committed BEFORE the first run (burned-gate-reanchor-is-tune-to-green). Editing any number here after a run has been read is tune-to-green and is forbidden. Gates are SEQUENTIAL: C0 -> C1 -> C2 -> P1; evaluate.py refuses to compute P1 unless every prior gate PASSes.
hypothesis: The bridge can only be EARNED by learning: a store-lookup bolted onto a frozen trunk fails, while co-training with per-example store rotation forces the trunk to learn to QUERY instead of memorise.
scope: DIRECTIONAL ceiling — v2/ lives outside core/, so no result here can ever be TERMINAL (a_engine_native_learning; every bypass died undecidable, H_9303/H_9307). A positive must be ported to an anima-py flag to earn a verdict.

budget.bolt_lr_selected_by: train_loss (NEVER eval DV — selecting on DV would be tune-to-green; giving BOLT its honest best shot is what makes its death evidence)

C0_instrument_integrity._fail: INSTRUMENT-DEAD — P1 is not computed or printed
C0_instrument_integrity._C0e_note: POSITIVE control added after run2 showed COTRAIN==NOSTORE. NOSTORE only proves the task does not leak; nothing proved the toy CAN show a positive, so a negative was unreadable (power-before-negative-verdict at the architecture level). ORACLE hands retrieval over for free. This ADDS a gate that can only make passing HARDER and was set before any P1 was computed - P1 has never been read, so no anchor is burned.

C1_power._fail: UNDERPOWERED — widen eval (data-independent repair is allowed), do NOT move the bar

P1_primary._note: macro = mean over the 4 cells (operator x polarity). Report cells BEFORE macro; if any single cell falls below macro-0.05 the macro is void (polarity-split-before-headline). Both seeds must agree.
P1_primary.grey_zone: 0.60-0.90 => NO-VERDICT (pre-registered ambiguity band; re-tuning the bar is forbidden)

contingency._note: declared BEFORE any run, so it is not tune-to-green
contingency.lambda_collapse_rerun: IF COTRAIN lambda < 0.05 AND P1 fails, ONE rerun with fixed lambda=0.5 is allowed. No other rerun.
